question.text: Where is the Investment Strategy of a Cat III AIF formally disclosed to investors?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Section 10.1 opening: 'The Investment Strategy is also disclosed to the investors, in the Private Placement Memorandum (PPM) of the fund.' PPM is the regulatory-prescribed document under SEBI (AIF) Regulations. **The Trap:** A, C, D are supplementary but not the regulatory-prescribed primary disclosure. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-D same PPM disclosure rule for Cat I/II. III-A/C (Compliance) tests PPM scope. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Any material deviation from PPM-stated strategy requires either PPM amendment (investor consent) or explicit investor notification. A Cat III AIF swinging from long-short to global-macro mid-life without PPM update is a SEBI inspection finding.
